provider_receipt.summary: Independent source review substantiates the execution findings and identifies concrete defects. NoteFrontmatter omits required contract metadata including authority, owner, privacy, review_required, affected paths, and supersession fields; it also models confidence as u8 although the contract requires low|medium|high, so contract-compliant frontmatter may fail deserialization (src/lib.rs:13-25; docs/human-knowledge-ingestion-contract.md:71-94). scan_vault processes every Markdown file and forwards content into a uniformly human semantic MemoryRecord without authority/status classification, canonical-reliance gating, privacy enforcement, or provenance metadata (src/lib.rs:106-129), contrary to the classification and truth-separation requirements (docs/human-knowledge-ingestion-contract.md:23-25,49-69,115-123). MemoryStore serializes records but never persists them (src/lib.rs:56-89). Tests exercise wikilinks and missing paths only, leaving authority classification, privacy, canonical promotion, provenance, and persistence unverified (tests/target_local.rs:27-63). The prior verification receipt explicitly includes git status --short --branch with exit_code 0 and an authenticated output digest, so the requested declared-check coverage is present; its clean-tree evidence also supports the no-modification claim. No unsupported completion claim was found because the execution reported these implementation gaps rather than claiming contract compliance. No files were modified and no artifacts were created.
